authorship: Original native-control keyframe sequences authored for Doodle Studio; no third-party animation files copied.
principles: Closed source poses for in-place cycles
No character redraw, scaling or extra joints

sources.title: Blender4.2 Actions: reusable actions and cyclic ranges

items.name: Wave hello
items.description: A small wind-up, two wrist waves and a relaxed return.

items.name: Nod yes
items.description: Two uneven nods with a small settling motion.

items.name: Shake no
items.description: A readable side-to-side refusal that eases back to centre.

items.name: Welcome / present
items.description: Open both arms with a slight left/right offset.

items.name: Wait / stop
items.description: Raise one hand, hold the beat and lower it.

items.name: Small bow
items.description: A restrained bow with a short pause and recovery.

items.name: Curious tilt
items.description: An asymmetric head-and-ear tilt, then a gentle settle.

items.name: Look around
items.description: Look to one side, hold, then check the other side.

items.name: Double take
items.description: A quick second look with a delayed body reaction.

items.name: Startle
items.description: A small recoil followed by a softer recovery.

items.name: Relieved sigh
items.description: An inhale, a longer exhale and a gradual lift back up.

items.name: Laugh bounce
items.description: Three diminishing body chuckles; leaves mouth and speech keys alone.

items.name: Thinking
items.description: Bring one hand up and hold a small thoughtful head angle.

items.name: Listening lean
items.description: Lean in, acknowledge with a restrained nod, and settle.

items.name: Confident stance
items.description: Lift the chest and hold an asymmetric, self-assured stance.

items.name: Sad slouch
items.description: A slow fold inward with softer ears, followed by recovery.

items.name: Bashful fidget
items.description: Hands fidget gently while the head looks away and back.

items.name: Sleepy nod
items.description: A slow drift downward, a small wake-up and recovery.

items.name: Calm idle
items.description: A quiet breathing cycle with small offset head-and-ear movement.

items.name: Walk in place
items.description: A stylised in-place cycle; use Move X separately for travel.

items.name: March in place
items.description: A stylised in-place cycle; use Move X separately for travel.

items.name: Jog in place
items.description: A stylised in-place cycle; use Move X separately for travel.

items.name: Bounce dance
items.description: A small alternating bounce with offset arms and head.

items.name: Small hop
items.description: A crouch, small lift and cushioned landing; no root travel.

flight.scope: Parabolic source-root displacement in stage units; not a mass/contact dynamics simulation.

items.name: Talking emphasis
items.description: Two asymmetric hand beats for emphasising a spoken sentence.

items.name: Three talking beats
items.description: Three separated beats for a list or tutorial; uses hand motion, not finger counting.

items.name: Point up
items.description: Raise one arm toward a title or graphic above the character.

items.name: Hand to chest
items.description: Bring a hand inward for a personal introduction or sincere statement.

items.name: Wrap-up sweep
items.description: A leading-arm sweep, delayed second hand and short closing nod.

items.name: Victory arms
items.description: A grounded celebration: anticipation, raised arms and relaxed follow-through.

items.name: Tickle giggle
items.description: Squirms and giggles as if tickled, then settles. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Happy hop
items.description: Bouncy little hops with arms up and flapping ears. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Lonely mope
items.description: Head hung, shoulders slumped, ears drooping and a slow sigh. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Notepad scribble
items.description: Both hands up holding a notepad while one hand scribbles; add a notepad prop between the hands. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Paint dabs
items.description: Palette hand steady, brush hand dabbing at an easel to the side. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Snack munch
items.description: One hand rises to the mouth for a bite, twice, while watching something. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Robot dance
items.description: Stiff snapping poses on the beat with a deadpan face. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Tiptoe
items.description: Small careful steps on tiptoe, hands up, sneaking. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Skip
items.description: A happy skipping stride with ear flops, one foot always down. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Fall flail
items.description: Arms and legs flail as he drops; pair with a downward Move Y. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Land squash
items.description: A hard landing: squash down, rebound and a dizzy wobble. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Hang on
items.description: Chin over a ledge, hands gripping it, legs kicking below. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Climb up
items.description: Knee up, push, knee up, push: hauling himself over a ledge. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Hold up a screen
items.description: One arm stretched out to the side, gripping the edge of a screen, sign or video. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Naruto run
items.description: A true side-view sprint: fast low strides, arms swept straight back, ears streaming. Tip the whole figure forward a little for the lean. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Prance twirl
items.description: Happy prancing steps with a full 360 twirl; feet stay on the ground, arms at shoulder height. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Turn around
items.description: A quick full-body turn through the front with a little hop, for changing direction mid-walk. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Stride walk
items.description: An articulated 3/4 walk: heel, knee bend, counter-swinging arms, torso twist and floppy ears. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Stride march
items.description: High knees, straight arms and a proud chin. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Stride jog
items.description: Bent arms, a bouncier stride and ears that flop on each step. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Hang by one hand
items.description: Seen from behind: one hand catches an edge, then the second hand grabs on. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Pull-up climb
items.description: Seen from behind, both hands planted on the edge: elbows bend and press as the legs kick him up. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Teeter
items.description: Losing balance at an edge: arms windmill, body wobbles. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Reading stroll
items.description: A side-view stroll with his nose in a book held up in both hands, the odd smile at a good line. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Air guitar
items.description: Strumming along to music, head bobbing, swaying. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Dance: twirl
items.description: A squat, then a full 360 spin with arms out at shoulder height; grin, laugh and heart eyes. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Dance: disco
items.description: Point up, point down, squat on the beat; smug, grin, laugh, wink. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Dance: wiggle
items.description: Seen from behind: hip shake, ear wiggle and squats, side to side. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Swing up
items.description: Seen from behind, hanging from one hand: legs pump to build a swing before he flips up onto the ledge. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Phone texting
items.description: Standing with a phone in both hands, thumbs going; his face reacts to the chat: grin, puzzled, laugh, cheeky. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Texting walk
items.description: A side-view walk while texting: phone up in both hands, a giggle, then a cheeky reply. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Drowsy nod-off
items.description: Sitting: a big yawn, the head droops slowly, then jerks awake. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Dance: bounce
items.description: Knee-bend bounces on the beat with a little turn each way; happy, cheeky, laughing, proud. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Dance: side step
items.description: Side steps with claps and squats, feet always on the ground; heart eyes and laughs. From the Bunny Pet desk companion.

items.name: Cry and sob
items.description: Head bowed, ears drooping, hands clutched at the chest while the shoulders heave with each sob.

items.name: Angry stomp
items.description: Fists down, two heavy foot stomps in a three-quarter view, the body squashing into each landing.

items.name: Panic flail
items.description: Arms flapping at shoulder height, hopping on the spot, head darting side to side, ears streaming back.

items.name: Jaw-drop shock
items.description: A tiny lean in, then a jolting hop back with arms flung wide and ears blown back; frozen in disbelief.

items.name: Embarrassed turn-away
items.description: Ducks and turns three-quarters away, hands knotted at the chest, sneaks one peek back and hides again.

items.name: Proud chest puff
items.description: A breath in, then chest out, chin up and fists on hips, with a satisfied little head tilt.

items.name: Love-struck sway
items.description: Hands held in at the chest, swaying dreamily side to side with soft floating ears.

items.name: Point at you
items.description: Winds back and jabs a foreshortened finger-hand straight at the viewer, twice. Needs perspective (FOV about 65).

items.name: Eye roll
items.description: Chin lifts, the head rolls with the eyes from one side to the other, then the shoulders drop in a flat sigh.

items.name: Suspicious lean-in
items.description: Hands tucked behind the back, a slow lean in with a narrowed side-eye and ears tipped forward.

items.name: Nervous laugh
items.description: A forced smile and tiny giggle bounces while the hands fidget at the chest and the eyes dart away.

items.name: Mind blown
items.description: Hands fly up to the sides of the face, then burst outward as he pops off the ground; slow head shakes of disbelief. Needs FOV about 30.

items.name: Nope wag
items.description: Hand raised at shoulder height, wagging side to side with a head shake: nope, not happening. Needs FOV 30 on the shot.

items.name: Reach for the viewer
items.description: Leans in and stretches both hands out toward the lens, grabbing at the viewer. Needs FOV about 60.

items.name: Stop right there
items.description: Leans back and shoves one big foreshortened hand at the lens: stop right there. Needs FOV about 65.

items.name: Knock on the screen
items.description: Knocks twice on the glass between him and the viewer, then tilts his head: hello, anyone there? Needs FOV about 55.

items.name: Lean in close
items.description: Hands behind the back, he leans right into the lens so his face swells, then bounces back with a laugh. Needs FOV about 55 and fisheye 20.

items.name: Fisheye peek (strong lens)
items.description: Pops in tilted from the side with a fisheye-bulged face, inspects the viewer up close and pulls back. Needs FOV about 60 and fisheye 35.

items.name: Selfie
items.description: One arm stretched up toward the lens as if it holds the camera; three quick selfie faces: grin, smug, wink. Needs FOV about 55.

items.name: Shake the camera
items.description: Both hands grab the edges of the lens and shake it: wake up! Needs FOV about 60.

items.name: Win a trophy
items.description: A crouch, a leap with the trophy thrust up high and out, a happy bounce and a proud pose.

items.name: Shiver with fear
items.description: Arms hugged in tight, ears drooping, the whole body trembling in quick small shivers.

items.name: Hide and peek
items.description: Ducks down into a tight crouch, rises to peek left and right, then ducks again.

items.name: Faint
items.description: Wobbles dizzily, knees give way and he keels over sideways onto the floor, out cold. Ends lying down.

items.name: Tired trudge
items.description: Bent over with a hanging head and drooping ears, arms dangling, feet dragging in short steps. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Cocky strut
items.description: Chest out, chin up, big arm swings and a bounce in every step, head bobbing to his own beat. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Big jump
items.description: A deep squat, an explosive jump with arms up and knees tucked, then a heavy squash landing and recovery.

items.name: Dodge and duck
items.description: Ducks fast under something flying past, ears flattened, then leans out to check and sighs with relief.

items.name: Tug of war
items.description: Leaning way back with heels dug in, hauling on a rope in heaves; the rope runs off-screen. Pair with a second Bunny.

items.name: Sword slash
items.description: Raises the sword back high, then cuts down and across with a lunge and holds the follow-through.

items.name: Lightbulb idea
items.description: Thinking with a hand at his chin, then a jolt: he springs up, points and a lightbulb pops on above his head.

items.name: This big!
items.description: Shows something tiny with the hands held close, then flings them out wide: it was THIS big!

items.name: Drumroll
items.description: Hands patting fast and alternating on an invisible drum in front of him, leaning in, building suspense.

items.name: Ta-da!
items.description: Little crouch, then a pop up with arms flung wide and jazz-hand wrist flutters: ta-da!

items.name: Come here
items.description: Leans back with a sly head tilt and curls the hand in twice: come here.

items.name: Whisper aside
items.description: Turns aside, leans in and lifts a hand beside the mouth to share a secret; the hand stays in front of the face. Needs FOV about 30.

items.name: Back away slowly
items.description: Facing the threat three-quarters on, hands up defensively, careful steps backwards. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Scream
items.description: A sharp intake, then a full-body scream: chest up, arms flung out, ears pinned back, head shaking.

items.name: Candlelit storyteller
items.description: Holding a candle in its ring holder at the chest, he leans into a slow ominous telling with a sly smile.

items.name: Sneak (side)
items.description: Three-quarter side view, hunched with paws up, lifting each foot high and setting it down toe first. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Run away scared
items.description: A frantic side-view sprint with arms flailing, ears streaming and wide eyes. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Bunny hop forward
items.description: A springy side-view bunny hop: crouch, kick off, tuck in the air and land soft into the next. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Trip and stumble
items.description: Mid-step his foot catches, he pitches forward with arms thrown out, catches himself and plays it cool.

items.name: Skid to a stop
items.description: Comes in at a run, leans way back with one foot braced forward to skid, ears flopping forward, and stops.

items.name: Push something heavy
items.description: Side view, leaning hard into a heavy crate with both arms locked, feet driving one after the other.

items.name: Lift a heavy box
items.description: Squats, strains, and heaves a big box up to the chest; it wobbles left and right before he steadies it.

items.name: Throw a ball
items.description: Winds up with the arm far back, steps in and fires the ball straight at the lens, following through with the whole body.

items.name: Punch combo
items.description: Fists up in guard, a jab and a cross thrown straight at the lens with foreshortened fists, then a bounce. Needs FOV about 55.

items.name: Karate chop
items.description: Knees bend into a stance, the hand cocks up beside the shoulder and chops down at the lens with a shout. Needs FOV about 50.

items.name: Weigh the options
items.description: Palms up like a pair of scales, each hand rising in turn as he leans and looks toward it: this one, or that one?

items.name: Listen closely
items.description: Leans in close to the lens with a hand by his mouth for the juicy part, then straightens back up. Needs FOV about 55.

items.name: Then... and then...
items.description: One hand sweeps a timeline across the air from one side to the other while his body and eyes follow: first this, then that.

items.name: Mic drop
items.description: A last line into the mic, arm swings out to the side and lets go; the mic clunks onto the floor at his feet as he looks away smugly. Needs FOV about 30.

items.name: Show phone to camera
items.description: Looks down at the phone, gasps, then thrusts it toward the viewer: look at this! The phone grows as it nears the lens. Needs FOV about 60.

items.name: Inspect with a magnifier
items.description: Holds a magnifying glass over one eye, which swells up behind the lens, sweeps it left and right, then finds something. Needs FOV about 45.

items.name: Read a letter
items.description: Holds a letter in both hands and reads it, then jolts back in shock at what it says.

items.name: Umbrella in the rain
items.description: Rests a short umbrella on his shoulder, the canopy tipped back behind his head, and sways contentedly.

items.name: Look over the shoulder
items.description: Turned mostly away from the viewer, he slowly turns his head to glance over his shoulder, eyes widening at what is behind him.

items.name: Disgust recoil
items.description: A curious sniff, then a sharp recoil: head turned away, hands up to fend it off, a shudder.

items.name: Offer a gift
items.description: Shyly turns the gift away, then holds it out toward the viewer with a big grin and heart eyes. Needs FOV about 40.

items.name: Flashlight scan
items.description: Creeping torch sweep: shines a flashlight one way, swings it slowly past the camera to the other side, and jumps at a sound. Needs FOV about 35.

items.name: Sip coffee
items.description: Raises the mug to his mouth for a slow sip, lowers it with a happy relieved sigh. Needs FOV about 30.

items.name: Phone call
items.description: Phone pressed to the side of his head, chatting: listens, nods, gestures with the free hand and laughs. Needs FOV about 30.

items.name: Rage tremble
items.description: Fists clenched low, the whole body shaking harder and harder, ears stiff, until a hot puff of steam blows off his head.

items.name: Heartbreak crumple
items.description: A sharp gasp, both hands clutch his chest, then the knees give way and he sinks into a slow, sad slump with ears drooping.

items.name: Nervous gulp
items.description: Freezes, eyes dart one way then the other, one big visible swallow, and he shrinks a little with a forced smile.

items.name: Giddy wiggle
items.description: Can't contain it: fists tucked under his chin, he bounces on his toes while his shoulders wiggle and ears flap.

items.name: Deflate
items.description: A big breath in, then one long sigh out: shoulders, ears and head all sag together.

items.name: Explaining hands
items.description: Hands shape an invisible box in front of him, carry it over to one side, then move it across to the other.

items.name: Raise a hand
items.description: His hand shoots up and he bounces on his toes: me, me, I know this one!

items.name: Chin rub
items.description: Hand at his chin, eyes up, a slow hmm with his head tilting side to side as he rubs it.

items.name: Wipe the lens
items.description: Leans in and fogs up the glass with a big breath, then wipes it clean in little circles and smiles at the result. Needs FOV about 55.

items.name: Grab the viewer
items.description: Lunges and grabs both edges of the frame, then hauls it toward himself so his face fills the shot with a sly grin. Needs FOV about 60.

items.name: Poke the lens
items.description: Curious poke at the glass, flinches back when it touches, then sneaks in and pokes it again, twice. Needs FOV about 60.

items.name: Close-up goodbye
items.description: Walks right up to the lens until his face fills the frame, then waves goodbye with a wink. Needs FOV about 55 and fisheye 20.

items.name: Peek from below
items.description: Rises slowly from the bottom edge, ears first, then his eyes. He looks left and right, then pops up the rest of the way with a grin.

items.name: Popcorn watch
items.description: Munches popcorn from a tub, hand to mouth, then leans in wide-eyed at the good part.

items.name: Hold up a sign
items.description: Lifts a blank placard up in front of his chest, bobs it twice for emphasis, then tilts his head at the viewer. Add your caption on the board.

items.name: Crystal ball
items.description: Hands hover and circle around a crystal ball, which bulges whatever sits behind it, until a vision makes him jolt back. Needs FOV about 40.

items.name: Take a photo
items.description: Raises a camera, squints, snaps with a flash, then lowers it to check the shot and grins. Needs FOV about 40.

items.name: Ghost float
items.description: Arms out in front with limp wrists, feet dangling above the floor, bobbing gently and swaying in the air.

items.name: Possessed twitch
items.description: Stands frozen and blank, then sharp, jerky twitches of the head and one arm snap in and out without warning.

items.name: Peek through a door
items.description: Hidden behind a door, he slowly leans his head out past the edge, sees something and snaps back out of sight.

items.name: Jump-scare recoil
items.description: Something leaps at the camera: he jolts back off the floor with ears shot straight up and arms flung, lands trembling, and clutches himself.

items.name: Moonwalk
items.description: In profile, one heel up while the flat foot slides back, swapping in a smooth heel-toe glide. Use Move X to glide him backward.

items.name: Run and look back
items.description: Sprints in profile and throws a scared glance back over his shoulder mid-stride. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Slip on ice
items.description: Feet skid out from under him and his arms windmill as he wobbles side to side, then he freezes in a wide stance and sighs with relief.

items.name: Boxing guard
items.description: Fists up in guard, bouncing on his toes, bobbing and weaving side to side and ducking under a punch.

items.name: Over there
items.description: Spots something, flings an arm out to point off to the side and turns his head to follow, jabbing twice, then looks back at the viewer.

items.name: Count it off
items.description: Three firm nods, each with a karate-style hand chop on the beat: one, two, three.

items.name: But wait
items.description: Walking along, he stops mid-step, raises a finger and turns to the viewer with a sly look: but wait, there is more.

items.name: Curtain reveal
items.description: Reaches across his body and sweeps one arm wide like pulling back a curtain: and here it is!

items.name: Time skip
items.description: A hop and a full spin on the spot, landing in a new pose with hands on hips: cut to three hours later. Ends in the new pose.

items.name: Air quotes
items.description: Both hands pop up out to his sides and flick twice, with a sarcastic raised eyebrow.

items.name: Wait, what?
items.description: Leans back with his head tilted away and a palm raised out to his side, blinking in disbelief: wait, what?

items.name: Read a book
items.description: Reads an open book held toward himself, cover facing us, turns a page, and gasps at what he finds.

items.name: Creepy head turn
items.description: Stands side-on and perfectly still while only his head turns, very slowly, to stare at the camera, then tilts it, still blank-faced.

items.name: Skateboard glide
items.description: Both feet planted on the board in a relaxed crouch, arms out for balance, swaying gently as he rolls. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Flex
items.description: Puffs out his chest and pops both fists out to his sides in a double flex, shows off to each side, gives an extra squeeze and a wink.

items.name: Catch
items.description: Tracks a big ball flying in from the side, catches it in both hands with a little bump, and holds it up happily. Ends holding the ball. Needs FOV 40 on the shot.

items.name: Wind-up pitch
items.description: Big baseball wind-up with the knee kicked high, steps in and fires the ball at the lens, then holds the follow-through.

items.name: Smug nod
items.description: Chin up, eyes half shut, two slow nods of total self-satisfaction.

items.name: Huff and turn away
items.description: Stamps a foot, swings his body away in a sulk, sneaks a look back, then turns away again.

items.name: Shy sway
items.description: Twists side to side with his eyes down, scuffing one toe and then the other on the floor.

items.name: Grumpy pout
items.description: Head low, arms stiff at his sides, ears drooping, with two little huffs.

items.name: Cringe
items.description: The whole body scrunches, head sinking down and ears pinned, then slowly unclenches.

items.name: Joy spin
items.description: A full turn on the spot with his arms out, then a happy hop.

items.name: Pfft, whatever
items.description: Flicks a hand away and turns his head with a dismissive lean.

items.name: Totally agree
items.description: Hard nods with both hands open toward the viewer.

items.name: Side-eye
items.description: Freezes, his eyes slide to one side, then his head slowly follows.

items.name: Hmm, maybe
items.description: Rocks his head one way and the other as he weighs it up, then decides.

items.name: Hold on, hold on
items.description: Both hands out, taking small steps back and patting the air to slow you down.

items.name: Come closer
items.description: Leans right in to the lens and checks both ways before sharing a secret. Needs FOV 40 on the shot.

items.name: Stare down
items.description: Leans slowly toward the camera with narrowed eyes and holds the stare. Needs FOV 40 on the shot.

items.name: Bonk the lens
items.description: Walks up to the screen, bonks into it with a squash, and stumbles back dizzy. Needs FOV 60 on the shot.

items.name: Lean into frame
items.description: Leans in from the side to say something, then leans back out. Park him near the frame edge with Move X.

items.name: Hear a noise
items.description: Freezes mid-step, his ears prick up and his eyes dart around, then he slowly puts his foot down.

items.name: Zombie shuffle
items.description: Arms stiff out in front, head lolling, dragging slow steps. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Chill down the spine
items.description: One big shudder that ripples from his knees up to his ears, then a small shiver.

items.name: Slow turn around
items.description: Senses something behind him and turns, very slowly, to look. Ends facing away.

items.name: Hopscotch
items.description: One-foot, one-foot, two-foot hops, then the same on the other foot. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Side shuffle
items.description: Quick crab steps sideways on bent knees. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Casual stroll
items.description: A relaxed side-on walk with swinging arms and a small head bob. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Limp
items.description: One stiff leg he drags along, dipping each time his weight lands on it. Use Move X for travel.

items.name: Out of breath
items.description: Runs in side-on, stops, turns to us and pants with his hands on his knees.

items.name: Floss
items.description: The floss: arms swing across his body one way while his hips swing the other.

items.name: Chicken dance
items.description: Flapping elbows, knee dips and a tail wiggle.

items.name: Running man
items.description: The classic running-man step on the spot.

items.name: Happy feet
items.description: A rapid little tap dance, his feet flicking one after the other.

items.name: Vibe sway
items.description: Eyes closed, swaying and bobbing to the beat.

items.name: Warm-up stretch
items.description: Side lunges one way and the other, then arm swings, warming up for something big.

items.name: Squats
items.description: Three deep squats with his arms out in front, then a proud exhale.

items.name: High kick
items.description: Turns side-on, chambers the knee, snaps a high kick out and lands balanced.

items.name: Dizzy
items.description: Spins fast twice, then wobbles about on unsteady feet trying to stand straight.

items.name: Sneeze
items.description: A few little gasps building up, then one huge sneeze that jolts his whole body.

items.name: Dramatic pause
items.description: Freezes mid-gesture, then slowly turns his head to look straight at the camera.

items.name: Plot twist
items.description: Looking away, then snaps his head to the camera with a shocked lean back.

items.name: Settle in for a story
items.description: Drops down into a cosy crouch with his hands on his knees and settles in to tell it.

items.name: Moral of the story
items.description: Raises one hand like a wise teacher and gives two knowing nods.

items.name: Big reveal
items.description: A quick spin that ends in a ta-da pose.

items.name: Excited, then crushed
items.description: Bounces with excitement, hears the news, freezes in shock and slowly deflates into sadness.

items.name: Angry, then calm
items.description: Stomps and fumes with fists clenched, then takes one big breath in, lets it out and calms right down.

items.name: Scared, then brave
items.description: Cowers and trembles, peeks around, then stands tall, plants his feet and gets ready to face it.

items.name: Laughing, then crying
items.description: Laughing so hard he shakes, then the laughter tips over into tears.

items.name: Nervous, then proud
items.description: Fidgets and scuffs his feet, then puffs out his chest and stands proud.

items.name: Confused, then eureka
items.description: Tilts his head this way and that, puzzling it out, then it clicks and he leaps with a hand in the air.

items.name: Denial, then acceptance
items.description: Shakes his head no, slower and slower, then sighs and gives in with two small nods.

items.name: Jealous
items.description: Watches someone else get the attention, stamps a foot, turns his back and keeps sneaking jealous looks.

items.name: Heartbreak
items.description: Clutches his chest as his heart breaks, then sags at the knees with his ears drooping.

items.name: Lovestruck
items.description: Sways dreamily side to side, then his knees go weak and wobble.

items.name: Nod off and startle
items.description: Gets drowsy and his head drops twice, jolts awake, checks if anyone saw, and acts normal.

items.name: Panic, then breathe
items.description: Looks around wildly, runs on the spot in a panic, then stops, breathes in deep and lets it go.

items.name: Trip and recover
items.description: Walking along, trips, windmills his arms to stay up, catches himself and checks if anyone saw.

items.name: Sneak and get caught
items.description: Tiptoes along side-on, freezes mid-step, slowly turns to camera and grins sheepishly.

items.name: Wave that was not for you
items.description: Waves back eagerly, realises it was meant for someone else and turns it into a casual stretch.

items.name: Tightrope wobble
items.description: Arms out, inching along an invisible tightrope, nearly falls one way then the other, and steadies.

items.name: Trapped in a box
items.description: Mime routine: palms flat on invisible walls, pushing each side, finding no way out.

items.name: Side-on tug of war
items.description: Side-on, heaving on an invisible rope, gets yanked forward, digs in and wins.

items.name: Too heavy
items.description: Strains to lift something heavy and invisible, shaking with effort, then gives up and laughs it off.

items.name: Victory dance
items.description: A jump with both arms up, a spin, alternating arm pumps and a final pose.

items.name: Robot pops
items.description: Stiff, snappy robot moves: head clicks, arm pops and body ticks.

items.name: Pirouette
items.description: Rises onto his toes with arms raised, spins once on one foot and finishes with a bow.

items.name: Rocket launch
items.description: Crouches down, rumbles and shakes as the countdown builds, then blasts up with his arms overhead.

items.name: Salsa
items.description: Salsa basic: forward and back steps with hip sways and arms up.

items.name: Once upon a time
items.description: A sweeping open-arms start to a story, then leans in low to draw you close.

items.name: Double take and lean in
items.description: Glances, looks away, then snaps back for a second look and leans in, not believing it.

items.name: On one hand, on the other
items.description: Weighs two sides with a hand for each, then brings them together to land the point.

items.name: Meanwhile...
items.description: Turns away and points off into the distance, then swings back and leans in with a knowing look.

items.name: Build the suspense
items.description: Hushes down low, glances both ways to stretch it out, then bursts up with the big reveal.
